_help: Add one object per business. Fields: id (unique, no spaces), name, cat (cafe|food|shop|museum|other), lat, lon, radius (meters to collect/stamp, default 60), card (short card title), story (1-2 lines about the place), offer (first-visit discount, once per person, optional), code (coupon code shown to staff), until (YYYY-MM-DD, optional), terms (optional), loy (optional loyalty card: {"n":10,"reward":"...","gap":20} = stamps needed, the reward, minimum hours between stamps; the same n and gap must be saved in the shop PIN record in admin.html), storyR (meters around a story that show this shop card, default 500), demo (true = demo tag, works from anywhere with PIN 123456).
